title: Ley Orgánica del Ambiente
citation: Gaceta Oficial de la República Bolivariana de Venezuela N° 5.833 Extraordinario, 22 December 2006
evidence: Asamblea Nacional law page (opened 2026-11-03) lists Nº Gaceta 5833 Ext., Fecha 22/12/2006, Condición Vigencia Total, and leaves the Vigencia date empty. The final provision in the gazette text reads: "Esta Ley entrará en vigencia transcurridos seis meses a partir de su publicación en la Gaceta Oficial de la República Bolivariana de Venezuela." No official page states the date, so it is null.
notes: Framework act for environmental management (replaces the 1976 Ley Orgánica del Ambiente). Official copies: the Asamblea PDF https://www.asambleanacional.gob.ve/storage/documentos/leyes/ley-organi-20220210161106.pdf (759657 bytes) gives 11 bytes from pdftotext; the MINEC copy https://www.minec.gob.ve/download/979/ (3871044 bytes) is the whole 32-page Gaceta 5.833 Extraordinario with an OCR layer, four laws interleaved by column and recognition errors in the text (for example 'Arto', 'interacrúan'), so it cannot be cut to this law without rewording. If counted from publication, six months ends 2007-06-22; that is arithmetic, not a stated date. Penalties are in ve-penal-environment-law. No government English translation: looked for on asambleanacional.gob.ve, minec.gob.ve and imprentanacional.gob.ve (law pages, Marco Jurídico list, home page); none found, so no translation record and no translation row. Record text is uncorrected OCR output of a scanned official PDF: the Asamblea Nacional PDF https://www.asambleanacional.gob.ve/storage/documentos/leyes/ley-organi-20220210161106.pdf (200 application/pdf, 759657 bytes, 11 pages, sha256 163a90fc17c162b9cc86949fd36b9b9de7b1f962c28d2b3454380f6242dac01c, size equals the first-pass size; the hash is first recorded here; pdftotext gives 11 bytes, so there is no text layer) was read as page images with tesseract 5.3.4, language pack tesseract-ocr-spa 1:4.1.0-2 (spa), --psm 4, from pdftoppm -r 200 renders, one column at a time (left then right) with the running head and page number cropped off. The file is a gazette excerpt, not the law alone: the law is pages 2 to 11 of the PDF (gazette pages 12 to 21): page 2 from the heading 'LA ASAMBLEA NACIONAL DE LA REPÚBLICA BOLIVARIANA DE VENEZUELA' in the left column (the refrendo block above it belongs to the Ley de Registro Público y del Notariado) and the whole right column, pages 3 to 10 in full, page 11 the promulgation ('Palacio de Miraflores ... Cúmplase') and the ministers' refrendo list down to the right-column rule above the Ley de Meteorología e Hidrología Nacional; page 1 (gazette cover, Sumario and the Ley de Registro Público) and the Meteorología heading on page 11 are not stored. Nothing was corrected, reflowed or reworded, so misread characters stay in the text and column order inside the signature blocks is not always kept. No 300 dpi pass was needed. The MINEC whole-gazette copy https://www.minec.gob.ve/download/979/ was not used. Languages stored on 2026-11-03: es (the only official language of Venezuelan gazette legislation; no indigenous-language edition and no ISO 639-1 code applies). No government English translation is known (see the first-pass note).

title: Ley Penal del Ambiente
citation: Gaceta Oficial de la República Bolivariana de Venezuela N° 39.913, 2 May 2012
evidence: Asamblea Nacional law page (opened 2026-11-03): Nº Gaceta 39.913, Fecha 02/05/2012, Vigencia 01/07/2012, Condición Vigencia Total.
notes: Criminal law for environmental offences; the page text states it repeals arts. 131 to 143 of the Ley de Gestión de la Diversidad Biológica. Official copies: the Asamblea PDF https://www.asambleanacional.gob.ve/storage/documentos/leyes/ley-penal--20211109143642.pdf (1103231 bytes) gives 9 bytes from pdftotext; the MINEC copy https://www.minec.gob.ve/download/1031/ (9464271 bytes) is the 96-page Gaceta 39.913 with an OCR layer covering many unrelated acts. The framework act is ve-organic-environment-law. No government English translation: looked for on asambleanacional.gob.ve, minec.gob.ve and imprentanacional.gob.ve (law pages, Marco Jurídico list, home page); none found, so no translation record and no translation row.
